notes: Sales returns on ST_TRNS_MAST/ST_TRNS_DET (types EFFECT 4, TRNS_TYPE 4), both legacy modes on one page (INVOICE_NO 'TYPE\SERIAL' = return against that invoice, empty = without invoice): numbering (DOC_NO_SEQ_RET, INVOICE_NO/INVOICE_REF), returned <= sold per lot, invoice prices/cost/tax, cost of returns, posted read-only, soft delete (APP_RULES_SA); wave 3: load the invoice items, item of an old lot (GET_THE_CONFIG), displays and notices (APP_ACT_ST)

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_e, i.name_a)) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_TRNS_DET.LOT_NO.sql: (select max(c.lot_number) from st_item_confg c where c.item_confg_id = t.item_confg_id)

ST_TRNS_DET.STORE_BALANCE.sql: case when (nvl(to_number(v('G_USER_CODE')), 0) = 0 or (select nvl(max(u.allow_view_balance), 0) from users u where u.users_code = to_number(v('G_USER_CODE'))) = 1) then round(nvl(get_balance_confg(t.store_code, t.group_code, t.item_code, t.item_confg_id, t.trns_date, t.date_serial, t.item_serial), 0) / nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1), 3) end

ST_TRNS_DET.STORE_COST.sql: case when (nvl(to_number(v('G_PASSWORD_NUMBER')), 0) = 0 or ((select nvl(max(b.show_cost), 0) from st_basic b) = 1 and (select nvl(max(u.allow_view_cost), 0) from users u where u.users_code = to_number(v('G_USER_CODE'))) = 1)) then get_unit_cost_confg(t.store_code, t.group_code, t.item_code, t.item_confg_id, t.trns_date, t.date_serial, t.item_serial) end

ST_TRNS_MAST.RET_INV_CODE.lov: select r.complaint_code || ' - ' || r.complaint_name d, r.complaint_code r from ret_inv_codes r order by r.complaint_code

ST_TRNS_MAST.TAX_CODE_MAST.lov: select x.tax_code || ' - ' || x.name_a d, x.tax_code r from tx_taxes_types x order by x.tax_code

ST_TRNS_DET.ITEM_CONFG_ID.lov: select c.item_confg_id || ' - ' || c.lot_number || ' - ' || to_char(c.expire_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') d, c.item_confg_id r from st_item_confg c where c.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE order by c.expire_date, c.item_confg_id

rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT T.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNS_TYPE T WHERE T.EFFECT = 4 AND T.TRNS_TYPE = 4) AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG,0) = 0 AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER,0) = 0 OR TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TP.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD TP WHERE TP.FLAG = 1 AND TP.PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))

row_rules.ST_TRNS_MAST: if app_rules_sa.doc_kind(:new.trns_type_code) in ('SI','SR') then app_rules_sa.trns_mast_row(inserting, :new.trns_type_code, :new.trns_serial, :new.trns_date, :new.doc_no, :new.invoice_no, :new.invoice_ref, :new.desc_a, :new.desc_e, :new.store_code, :new.customer_code, :new.salesman_code, :new.currency_code, :new.currency_rate, :new.due_days, :new.due_date, :new.delete_flag, :new.print_flag, :new.return_type_flag, :new.ret_trns_type_code, :new.ret_trns_serial, :new.order_trns_type_code, :new.order_trns_serial, :new.demo_trns_type_code, :new.demo_trns_serial, :new.trnsport_val); end if;
row_rules.ST_TRNS_DET: if app_rules_sa.doc_kind(:new.trns_type_code) in ('SI','SR') then app_rules_sa.trns_det_row2(inserting, :new.trns_type_code, :new.trns_serial, :new.item_serial, :new.group_code, :new.item_code, :new.unit_code, :new.item_confg_id, :new.quantity, :new.bonus, :new.extra_bonus, :new.extra_bonus_ratio, :new.basic_qty, :new.unit_price_curr, :new.unit_price, :new.disc1_ratio, :new.disc1_value, :new.disc2_ratio, :new.disc2_value, :new.disc3_ratio, :new.disc3_value, :new.det_disc, :new.disc, :new.cost_flag, :new.unit_cost, :new.store_code, :new.tax_code1, :new.tax_value1, :new.auto_disc, :new.org_disc1_ratio, :new.org_disc2_ratio, :new.org_disc3_ratio, :new.org_bonus_ratio, :new.org_unit_price_curr, :new.org_extra_bonus_ratio, :new.org_class_code, :old.item_code, :old.unit_code, :old.item_confg_id, :old.quantity, :old.bonus, :old.extra_bonus, :old.unit_price_curr); end if;
row_rules.ST_TRNS_SERVICES: if app_rules_sa.doc_kind(:new.trns_type_code) in ('SI','SR') then app_rules_sa.trns_srv_row(inserting, :new.trns_type_code, :new.trns_serial, :new.service_code, :new.service_cost, :new.units_no, :new.tax_code1, :new.tax_value1); end if;

params.name: ITEM
params.lov_sql: select item_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', name_e, name_a) d, item_code r from st_item where nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 order by item_code

params.name: UNIT
params.lov_sql: select unit_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', name_e, name_a) d, unit_code r from st_unit order by unit_code
